artifact.body:
Dear Ms. Weber,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding the sample kit for the Matte Series (Ref: NT-SMP-2026-04).

Status: The samples are currently undergoing final quality control checks at our Berlin warehouse. Due to a minor labeling adjustment, the release date has been shifted.

Next Step: The kit is now scheduled for dispatch on February 10th. We will provide the DHL tracking number via email once the package leaves our facility. Please ensure someone is available to receive the delivery, as the samples are fragile.

Best regards,
Nora Wells
Quality Support Employee
Nordton Export Desk
